description: Bring-your-own-agent support for AWS Bedrock Converse. Define agents as JSON files and use them as language models.
agentFilesDescription: List of agent definition files or glob patterns, resolved against each workspace folder. Absolute file paths are also supported. Each JSON file defines one agent backed by an AWS Bedrock Converse model.
configRegionDescription: Default AWS region for Bedrock requests. Agent files may override this. Falls back to the AWS_REGION environment variable, then us-west-2.
configProfileDescription: Optional named AWS profile from the shared credentials/config files. Leave empty to use the default credential provider chain (environment variables, shared files, SSO, IAM roles).
configAccessKeyIdDescription: Optional explicit AWS access key ID. Prefer the default credential chain or a named profile when possible.
configSecretAccessKeyDescription: Optional explicit AWS secret access key. Required when an access key ID is set.
configSessionTokenDescription: Optional AWS session token for temporary credentials.
